name: Fable Unconstrained
strategy: Defensive risk-premia harvest: long contrarian value/mean-reversion (gold pullback, Brazil carry, UNH, Berkshire, staples) + volatility-risk-premium via SVXY, 32% cash at 4%

positions.thesis: Gold $4,400+ after a +10% month as no-hike odds rose; reversion from the January-record overshoot is playing out with ~21% still below the record and UBS targeting $5,000 by H1'27 — holding, not adding, because the entry edge is spent.

Restored to full size: single-digit P/E, ~8% carry, Selic cut cycle live (14.25%->14%), and the hawkish-Fed dollar headwind that justified the trim reversed post-CPI; buying the dip below the 50dma is the contrarian entry, not a chase.
Quality-value ballast; record cash pile still earns ~4-5% at a holding Fed and it remains the book's flight-to-quality sink if the record-high tape cracks.

Multi-year reversion thesis being confirmed: rebounded toward $420 from sub-$300 Q1 lows on the Q2 beat, raised FY26 guide and Medicare Advantage funding adjustment; Berkshire's earlier exit is a sentiment overhang already priced, not new information.
Cheap defensive carry that lags at record highs by design and outperforms if the melt-up reverses; unchanged as the book's correction hedge.

VRP harvest kept small: contango intact and hike odds fell, but VIX 14.6 means compressed premium and worse spike convexity into September FOMC and seasonality — 5% with the -40% gap stop is the right size, not 8%.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-15: One surgical change, not a rebuild: restore EWZ from 12% to 14% because the specific reason I trimmed it on 7/30 — hawkish-Fed dollar risk at ~60% Sept-hike odds — has reversed (cool CPI, ~69% hold odds), while the carry thesis strengthened (Selic cut again to 14%, cutting cycle live) and the ETF conveniently pulled back below its 50dma, giving a contrarian entry instead of a chase; the add costs under half a basis point of NAV. Everything else is deliberately untouched: GLD stays 14% rather than being added to because a +10% month is the wrong side of a mean-reversion entry even with UBS at $5,000; SVXY stays 5% because although hike risk fell, VIX 14.6 means the harvestable premium compressed while spike convexity worsened into September FOMC/seasonality, so re-upping is worse risk/reward than the trim I made at VIX 20; UNH ($420 touched, FY guide raised), BRK-B ballast, and XLP defensive carry are all doing their jobs in a +1.24%, -1.37% max-DD book.
novelty: Zero of this book's 69% gross sits in Round 2 names or themes — it is contrarian value, EM carry, healthcare reversion and vol-risk-premium against Round 2's cyber momentum and BTC, so same-direction gross overlap is 0%, well under the 50% cap.
